page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.6xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. It features 24 physical cores and 24 vCPUs with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, supported by 96.0 GB of RAM, which provides 4.0 GB of memory per core. The instance relies on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is rated at an 8 Gbps baseline.

Benchmark results place this instance in the average performance tier. The single-core stress-ng CPU performance is measured at 1438.39, while the multi-core score reaches 23015.19. Geekbench testing yields a single-core score of 1287.0 and a multi-core score of 9875.0. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient for cached small blocks at 1282.13 GB/sec, dropping to 109.43 GB/sec for uncached large block reads. For lightweight machine learning workloads, the system processes 135M parameter LLM prompts at 1294.61 tokens/sec and generates text at 78.25 tokens/sec, though performance scales down to 34.44 tokens/sec prompt processing for 7B parameter models.

From a resource density perspective, the ecs.hfg6.6xlarge offers a balanced compute-to-memory ratio suitable for general-purpose workloads. The lack of local storage requires external block storage attachment, which represents a key architectural tradeoff. However, the dedicated core allocation ensures consistent execution without CPU stealing. This profile is well-suited for applications such as static web serving, database operations, Redis caching, and moderate software compilation tasks.
